facts.value: Go to Professional Education Programmes, choose the MicroCred of your choice, read 'Entry Requirements' for required documents, click Apply button and create a username and password, upload required documents, pay application fee of €50, submit your application.
Applicants must upload their educational documents. UL graduates do not need to upload UL Transcripts.
The fee allows you to apply for up to three MicroCreds in one online application.
If you experience any difficulty with your application, please contact us.
Remember to use upper and lower case letters, numbers, and symbols in your password.
Google Chrome can cause problems in some instances when creating an account.
If you have previously submitted an application but are unable to remember your password, please use the forgotten password.
